model: WRF06 RC / WRF07 RC BACnet MS/TP room controllers
equipment_type: Room controller (fan coil, radiator, chilled ceiling)
applies_to: Thermokon WRF06 RC and WRF07 RC wall-mounted room controllers with RS485 BACnet MS/TP, including the humidity (x rH) variants.
summary: WRF06 RC and WRF07 RC are wall-mounted room controllers with a built-in PI controller, setpoint knob, buttons and up to two outputs (0-10 V, relay, triac or 6-way valve), plus up to four digital inputs. Everything is configured over BACnet MS/TP: device type, PI parameters, fan stages, button, LED and input functions. The BMS can command occupancy, mode and fan stage, override the outputs and drive the LEDs.
firmware: 1.0.0 or later (BV 114 needs 1.1.0, writable device name 3.0.6)
notes: Object list from the 'Description for WRF06 RC / WRF07 RC BACnet MS/TP' manual, rev E (30.01.2026), section 2 (pages 9-14). The manual gives each object only an ID and a description; the description is used as the name here.
Multistate state texts are listed in the order printed; the manual does not print their numbers.
Objects from AV 100, BV 100 and MV 100 up are configuration parameters kept through a restart.
Which inputs and outputs are used depends on the device type (MV 100): AO2V, DO2R, DO2T, OVR, OVT, 4DI or the 6-way-valve types for Belimo and Sauter valves.
The manual has no access column; R/W here is inferred (inputs read-only, values and outputs writable).

integration.summary: Set the MAC address and baud rate on the DIP switches, then set the device type (MV 100) and controller parameters. From the BMS, command occupancy with BV 3, the mode with MV 0 (needed for change-over) and the fan stage with MV 1, write the base setpoint (AV 1), and read room temperature, active setpoint and the controller outputs.

minimum_points.name: PI-Ctr. Mode Override
minimum_points.why: Mode: off, heat, cool or automatic

integration.enable: PI-Ctr. Enable (BV 1) turns the built-in controller on; Occupancy Override (BV 3) sets occupied/unoccupied, and PI-Ctr. Mode Override (MV 0) sets off/heat/cool/automatic. In change-over operation (BV 112) the heat/cool mode must be given through MV 0.
integration.remote_sensors: Energy hold-off (BV 0) and dew-point (BV 2) can be set from the BMS as well as from wired inputs. The outputs can be overridden with AO 0 and AO 1 (0-10 V); writing -1 returns them to automatic.
setup: MAC address 1-127 and baud rate (9600-115200) on DIP switches; 8N1.
Device instance = Offset Device ID (AV 100) + MAC address.
Pick the output configuration with Device Type (MV 100) before tuning the controller.
gotchas: The '(saved)' button, switch and input objects latch an event until they are read, and the input counters reset to 0 on read; only one BMS client should poll them.
Objects numbered 100 and up are stored settings; avoid cyclic writes.
